title: Ice Climber
shortDescription: Ice Climber joins the Nintendo Entertainment System platformer path in GameAtlas with a clearly labeled catalog-method note and Wikidata link.
highlights: Frames a platformer catalog entry for source-aware Nintendo Entertainment System exploration.
